title: Verbs That Shift Meaning with Mood
goal: Distinguish the indicative and subjunctive meanings of decir, sentir, entender/comprender, temer and suponer.

items: I can contrast the indicative and subjunctive meanings of *decir*, *sentir*, *entender*, *temer* and *suponer*.
I can choose the mood that matches whether a sentence reports/assumes a fact or expresses an order, regret, sympathy or consequence.
I can use key terms for interpretation, context, assumptions and implicit vs. explicit meaning.
